gateway.existingProxy.zh-CN: 现有自动代理（PAC/WPAD）暂不支持合并。原配置已保留，请检查系统代理设置。
gateway.existingProxy.en-US: Existing automatic proxy settings (PAC/WPAD) cannot be combined yet. Your previous settings are preserved; check the system proxy configuration.

gateway.restoreError.zh-CN: 未能安全恢复原代理设置。请检查系统代理后重试；不会强行覆盖其他应用修改的配置。
gateway.restoreError.en-US: The previous proxy settings could not be safely restored. Check the system proxy and retry. Changes made by other apps will not be overwritten.

gateway.loginRequired.zh-CN: 请先在 OneTHU 登录校园账号，再启动代理。
gateway.loginRequired.en-US: Sign in to your campus account in OneTHU before starting the proxy.

gateway.recoveryRequired.zh-CN: 检测到上次尚未恢复的系统代理配置。请点击「恢复原代理设置」；其他应用后来修改的配置不会被覆盖。
gateway.recoveryRequired.en-US: System proxy settings from an earlier session need recovery. Choose “Restore proxy settings”. Later changes made by other apps will not be overwritten.

gateway.description.zh-CN: 让日常浏览器通过本机代理访问校园网站，共用 OneTHU 当前登录会话。无需扩展；启动后只在本机监听。
gateway.description.en-US: Access campus websites in your usual browser using the current OneTHU session. No extension is needed; starting the proxy opens a local listener only.

gateway.desktopOnly.zh-CN: 手机端校园网关尚未启用。当前监听仅限电脑本机，手机无法通过电脑的 127.0.0.1 接入。
gateway.desktopOnly.en-US: The mobile campus gateway is not enabled yet. The desktop listener is loopback-only; a phone cannot connect to the computer’s 127.0.0.1.

gateway.checking.zh-CN: 正在检查本地运行环境…

gateway.installRequired.zh-CN: 请先在上方安装或更新 OneTHU CLI 运行环境，无需打开「外部客户端访问」开关。
gateway.installRequired.en-US: Install or update the OneTHU CLI runtime above. External client access can remain off.

gateway.unavailable.zh-CN: 暂时无法读取代理状态，请刷新重试。
gateway.unavailable.en-US: Proxy status is unavailable. Refresh to retry.

gateway.error.zh-CN: 操作未完成，请刷新状态后重试。
gateway.error.en-US: The action could not be completed. Refresh the status and try again.

gateway.errorCode.zh-CN: 操作未完成（{code}），请刷新状态后重试。
gateway.errorCode.en-US: The action could not be completed ({code}). Refresh the status and try again.

gateway.browserDescription.zh-CN: 也可打开独立的 Chrome 窗口访问校园网站，无需扩展或系统证书授权。日常浏览器使用上方的系统代理接入。
gateway.browserDescription.en-US: You can also open a separate Chrome window for campus websites without an extension or system certificate approval. Use the system proxy above for your usual browsers.

gateway.browserOpened.zh-CN: 已发起打开校园浏览器，请在新窗口中访问校园网站。
gateway.browserOpened.en-US: Campus browser launch requested. Use the new window to visit campus websites.

gateway.accountPending.zh-CN: 请检查 OneTHU 登录状态

gateway.advanced.zh-CN: 可选浏览器与手动接入

gateway.advancedDescription.zh-CN: 打开独立浏览器，或查看平台支持范围、证书详情和本机代理凭据。
gateway.advancedDescription.en-US: Open a separate browser, or view platform support, certificate details and local proxy credentials.

gateway.authorizationScope.zh-CN: 普通浏览器保留身份站的原连接。受签名验证的微信客户端仅可为清小搭、行在清华的已登记服务借用校园会话；学校要求的二次验证仍需本人完成。停止代理可恢复原网络配置。
gateway.authorizationScope.en-US: Regular browsers retain their original identity-service connection. Signature-verified WeChat clients can borrow the campus session only for registered Qingxiaoda and Xingzai services. Any additional verification required by the university remains yours to complete. Stopping the proxy restores the previous network settings.

gateway.certificateMissing.zh-CN: 启动代理后会生成本机证书；还需单独点击授权信任，不会自动安装。
gateway.certificateMissing.en-US: Starting the proxy creates a local certificate. Trust requires a separate action; the certificate is not installed automatically.

gateway.trusted.zh-CN: 已信任，可启用系统校园代理。
gateway.trusted.en-US: Trusted. The campus system proxy can be enabled.

gateway.untrusted.zh-CN: 尚未信任。请授权信任后再启用系统代理。
gateway.untrusted.en-US: Not yet trusted. Approve certificate trust before enabling the system proxy.

gateway.trustUnknown.zh-CN: 已准备证书，系统信任状态未确认。
gateway.trustUnknown.en-US: Certificate prepared. System trust has not been confirmed.

gateway.systemUnsupported.zh-CN: 当前系统暂不支持自动接入，可展开下方查看其他接入方式。
gateway.systemUnsupported.en-US: Automatic system integration is unavailable on this platform. Expand the options below for other connection methods.

gateway.systemEnabled.zh-CN: 已启用，遵循系统代理设置的浏览器可直接使用。停用后恢复原代理设置，再按需撤销证书信任。
gateway.systemEnabled.en-US: Enabled for browsers that follow system proxy settings. Disable to restore previous proxy settings, then remove certificate trust if desired.

gateway.systemDescription.zh-CN: 启动代理并信任证书后，点击启用。遵循系统代理设置的浏览器即可访问校园站点；macOS 可保留现有手动代理供其他网站使用。
gateway.systemDescription.en-US: Start the proxy and trust its certificate, then enable it for browsers that follow system proxy settings. On macOS, an existing manual proxy can continue handling other websites.

gateway.credentialsDescription.zh-CN: 用于手动配置其他应用，不是校园账号密码。仅主动显示时读取，60 秒后自动隐藏。
gateway.credentialsDescription.en-US: For manually configuring other apps. These are not your campus account credentials. They are retrieved only when you choose to reveal them and hidden after 60 seconds.

gateway.passwordCopied.zh-CN: 代理密码已复制到剪贴板。
gateway.passwordCopied.en-US: Proxy password copied to the clipboard.

gateway.copyError.zh-CN: 无法复制，请从已显示的代理密码框中手动复制。
gateway.copyError.en-US: Could not copy. Copy manually from the revealed proxy password field.

gateway.systemFlow.zh-CN: ① 启动代理　② 授权信任证书　③ 启用系统代理；每一步均需主动点击。
gateway.systemFlow.en-US: 1. Start proxy → 2. Trust certificate → 3. Enable system proxy. Each step requires your action.

gateway.coexistence.zh-CN: 已保留原手动代理供其他网站使用 · 网络服务：{services}
gateway.coexistence.en-US: Previous manual proxies are preserved for other websites · Network services: {services}

gateway.platformScope.zh-CN: macOS 与 Windows 可保留原手动代理及绕过规则；现有 PAC/WPAD 需先由用户处理。Windows 接入范围是当前用户的系统代理，独立网络栈需单独验收。Android 与 iOS 的系统接入尚需原生桥；手机微信的证书信任也需真机确认。Android 同时只能启用一个 VPN，请保留现有 VPN 配置。
gateway.platformScope.en-US: macOS and Windows preserve manual proxies and bypass rules; existing PAC/WPAD requires user configuration. Windows integration covers the current user’s system proxy; independent network stacks require separate testing. Android and iOS still require native system bridges and device testing of WeChat certificate trust. Android permits one active VPN per profile; preserve your existing VPN configuration.

gateway.planChanged.zh-CN: 系统代理在准备期间被其他应用修改。请刷新状态后重试；不会覆盖后来的修改。
gateway.planChanged.en-US: Another app changed the system proxy during setup. Refresh the status and retry; later changes will not be overwritten.

gateway.authenticatedProxy.zh-CN: 现有手动代理需要认证，暂不支持合并。原代理配置未被覆盖。
gateway.authenticatedProxy.en-US: The existing manual proxy requires authentication and cannot be combined yet. Its settings were not overwritten.

gateway.prepareClientsDescription.zh-CN: 由当前 OneTHU 窗口检查学校授权；小程序登录时转交学校签发的短时服务票据，密码保留在本机既有登录流程中。微信自身的登录、学校额外验证与小程序实际支持情况需分别确认。
gateway.prepareClientsDescription.en-US: Check university authorization through this OneTHU window. Mini-program sign-in receives a short-lived, university-issued service ticket; passwords stay in the existing local sign-in flow. WeChat sign-in, additional university verification, and actual mini-program support remain separate checks.
